description: Stops an address delivering into a box. What already arrived through it stays in the box, and each message still says which name it came in on.

address.description: The address of the mailbox, for example "marie@sonentreprise.com": call list_mailboxes to find it. A support queue is not a mailbox: it has no holder and takes no alias.

alias.description: The name to take away, from list_mailboxes.

name: remove_mailbox_alias
title: Remove a name from a mailbox
